## Details

<a id="missile_move"></a>
### [`missile_move`](../../../../src/missile/missile_update_5870.asm#L6) `$5870`

*routine*

Moves each active missile one column. Direction +1 moves left, direction $ff moves right. A missile that leaves columns 0-39 frees its slot.

- **Called from:** [`$41AB`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L69)
- **Reads:** [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`temp2`](../../memory-map.md#temp2)
- **Writes:** [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`gauge_colour`](../../memory-map.md#gauge_colour), [`temp2`](../../memory-map.md#temp2)
